[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Issue and service of summons
 Section: O5R22::Service within presidency-towns of summons issued by Courts outside.
]


Where a summons issued by any Court established beyond the limits of the towns of Calcutta, Madras 3[and Bombay] is to be served within any such limits, it shall be sent to the Court of Small Causes within whose jurisdiction it is to be served.

metadata.section_title: Service within presidency-towns of summons issued by Courts outside.
